class_guess: Bell eats counter, partial eat (leftover digits ride in next counter)
summary: Mirrored FractalBEC bounce+counter; C1 makes the eat partial: N grows +1/+3/+4+r per epoch, leftovers ride along
mechanism: Mirror of FractalBEC tm10: blocks (110)^a 0 (011)^b on the left, a binary counter on the right; each bounce adds 1.
C1 differs: when b runs out the bell eats the counter only partly, so N grows by 1, 3 or 4+r per epoch, never doubles.
Uneaten digits stay as inert 1s inside the next counter (residue); carries pass straight through them.

vars: n (left record; next epoch has N = n+1 blocks)

rules.name: R1c bounce, clean counter
rules.steps: 8b+8, plus 6t+8 if t>0 (t = trailing 1-bits of a)
rules.cases: a>=1, b>=1. enc(v) = v0 010 (00 v1)(00 v2)...(00 vk), LSB first, trailing 0s trimmed; covers top-digit overflow at a=2^k-1

rules.name: R1g bounce, any counter word
rules.cases: b>=1; X = counter words with residue sampled from epochs N=37 and N=331; X' depends on X only (a,b inert; tested a<=3000, b<=1500)

rules.name: E0 epoch end, N even (clean start)
rules.cases: N even, N>=2. enc3(m) = (00 m0)(00 m1)... LSB first. N' = N+1. ~4N^2 steps

rules.name: E1 epoch end, N = 3 mod 4 (clean start)
E2 epoch end, N = 1 mod 4 (clean start)
rules.cases: N = 1 mod 4; r = run of 1-bits of N starting at bit 2 (r=0..7 tested). N' = N+4+r. N up to 14077

template.diff: mirror of tm10 = 1RB0RF_1RC1RF_1LD1RB_---0LE_1LA0LE_0RA0LC; only C1 differs: 1RB -> 1RA
template.note: On ours RInc 4/4 and Ov 8/8 hold; LInc fails for every odd counter (8/16, C reads LSB 1 -> 1RA) and config i -> i+1 fails 5/6. Bounce shape carries over; counter encoding and doubling epoch map do not.

strategy: BECv7/FractalBEC shape: prove R1 (shift rule + counter increment over a residue-tolerant digit word, Inductive like BECv7) with ind; then an epoch lemma K(1,N-1,X) -->+ K(1,N'-1,X') with N'>N; nonhalt via multistep_nonhalt + progress_nonhalt_cond, invariant 'X in residue language'. E0-E2 alone do not close: real orbit almost never has a clean counter.
risks: General epoch map with residue not found yet: dN depends on residue (N=21: clean +5, with residue +10).
Residue language may be big: 6-factors stable (23) but 8-factors still new at epoch 178; zero runs up to 20.
Probably 15-30 KB of Rocq (counter-with-separators encoding); twin holdout 1RB0RE_1RC1RE_1LD1RA_1LA0LD_0RA0LF_1LD--- shares the trajectory.

checkpoint_questions.text: Fig 1: ours has many epochs that grow a little each time; the template has few that grow ~4x. Agree this is a new epoch map, not a template tweak?
Fig 2: do the isolated residue 1s between counter digits stay put while carries pass through them (inert separators)?
